items.headline: Container rates diverge sharply by trade lane
items.summary: Per Seatrade Maritime, transpacific and Atlantic spot rates are surging toward pandemic-era highs even as Asia-Europe rates soften, while carrier schedule reliability continues to deteriorate.

items.headline: ACER consults on REMIT/EMIR reporting overlap
items.summary: ACER opened a public consultation on guidance for reporting energy derivative transactions under both REMIT and EMIR, aiming to reduce duplicate filings caused by inconsistent scope definitions across frameworks.

items.headline: Commodity trade finance market forecast raised again
items.summary: A new market report projects the commodity trade finance sector growing from about $59.7bn in 2026 to $81.45bn by 2030, citing blockchain-based settlement and real-time risk monitoring as key growth drivers.

items.headline: CTRM vendor Previse Systems reports strong growth
items.summary: Industry analyst coverage highlighted Previse Systems' continued expansion in the CTRM space, based on comments from the vendor's Chief Revenue Officer on its recent commercial momentum.
